name: Ariya Takajou
source:
Japanese girl, succesor of the "White Pile" title.

Her only desire is to destroy every vampire in existence. Although just a human, she is capable of opposing them in a fight. She uses a short blade and stake launcher worn of her right arm.

After being defeated by him, she becomes fixated on killing Toshirou.
